_comment: A DECK THAT GROWS — ONE deck for a whole feature. You edit THIS file and re-build it each round; you never start a new spec for the same feature. His submitted answers are kept beside it as dated files and become the earlier rounds.

A topic he answered in an earlier round sinks into the 'Previously answered' card at the foot of its page, drawn as its original card, locked, and is never asked again unless he presses Reopen. Open topics stay on top. The deck is AT one stage ("stage"): the stage line lets him press a finished stage's name to read its pages (marked Finished); only the current stage's pages ask him anything.

Each round: (1) read his answers, (2) for every topic where he asked for a change, add "reopened" (one line of its past; the topic is open again, with your revised proposal) or "resolved" (what you did about it; it stays answered), (3) add new topics, (4) rebuild with the same file name. The builder refuses to rebuild if one of his changes would vanish silently.

Page intros are ONE plain line (max 160 characters). A title, a row's bold or plain line, or a page intro may not name a round or a step id: say it plainly and put where it came from in "more" (a row's "more" opens behind a small More link).
title: Saved searches
_comment_title: title: the feature, in his words. The same title and file name every round.
_comment_key: key: a short name; his answers are saved under it. Keep it the same every round.
_comment_grows: grows: true switches all of this on. A deck without it behaves exactly as before.
_comment_stage: stage: the stage this deck is AT now (understanding, design, before, after). Refused: a page of a LATER stage; an open topic (not answered, not a background list) on a page of an EARLIER stage; a reopened topic anywhere but the current stage; no page at the current stage. Move the deck on by changing this when a stage is done.
_comment_rounds_before: rounds_before (optional): how many separate decks this feature already had. Round numbers then start after them. Leave it out (or 0) for a feature with no earlier decks.
_comment_retired: retired: {"<step id>": "why it went"}. A topic he answered earlier cannot just disappear from the deck; list it here when you remove it on purpose.

steps._comment: A page marker. On a deck that grows every page names its STAGE (understanding, design, before, after), and the stages go in that order.
steps.intro: Mark what holds and what does not.

steps._comment: A topic he answered earlier. 'answered' is a list, oldest first, one entry per round: {round, given: his saved answer as the answers file holds it}. The old {round, answer, notes} shape still works.
